build_ppo_builder: build a PPOBuilder instance with a PPOConfig to construct PPO reinforcement learning components
create_replay_tables: create reverb replay tables with queue storage for PPO trajectory data using environment specs
create_dataset_iterator: create a multi-device dataset iterator from a reverb replay client for PPO learning batches
create_ppo_learner: create a PPOLearner with optax Adam optimizer and GAE advantage estimation for training
create_ppo_actor: create a PPO actor with optional observation normalization and variable client for inference
